text_block_list.text: In the morning, while taking a walk before work started—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*...!
Hehe, Blast-chan, who won that just now!?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that pretty much a tie?
The white-line-only course and the shadow-only course!
I had trouble deciding where to put my feet!
choice_data_list: Good morning! Both of you are so full of energy this morning.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, good morning!
Of course, I'm full of energy!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: I had so much energy that I went and ran a little race!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: A morning running course, commemorating nostalgic childhood games... or something like that!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "Thanks for going along with my spur-of-the-moment idea, Blast-chan!"
I watched the backs of the two as they dashed away. ...They sure are full of energy so early in the morning.

“—A little while later,
when I took a break from work and headed to the school store...”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That concludes our reconnaissance, Sergeant Blast.
Did you properly memorize the distance
from the store entrance to the target?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Of course, boss... I mean, yes, sir,
Captain Kiseki! We can take the shortest route!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! The moment the chime rings,
I shall breach the classroom—and lead the charge!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Tailing right behind them, pushing through the crowd... Target secured!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Snacks from that manga collab Kiseki likes...
Let's get some and eat them together~!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The next scene I draw is definitely going to be amazing...!
I can't afford to mess this up...!
I've got to make it absolutely, undeniably unforgettable...!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
You're really getting into it, Kiseki.
Oh, watch out for the tree ahead—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, thanks!
That was close, so close...!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, look Kiseki!
The farrier is here!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...! You're right!
I might be able to get advice on that idea I just had!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Excuse meee! Do you have a moment
to talk about horseshoes?!
choice_data_list: (I mean, we've been together the whole time!)

text_block_list.text: And furthermore—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki & Blast
text_block_list.text:
Haaahhaaaaaahhh!!
Taaahhhhhaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Kh, haa, haa...!
Blast-chan, you really are fast...!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Heh, heheh...!
I was thinking the exact same thing about Kiseki...!

When I went to the training track,
Kiseki and Blast Onepiece had already finished their runs.
This wasn't supposed to be on the schedule, but...
choice_data_list: Huh? Did you make plans to train together?
Huh? Did you make plans to train together?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh? No... we didn't make any promises.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
The course was wide open anyway.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki & Blast
text_block_list.text:
Because Blast-chan just happened to be there.
Because Kiseki just happened to be there.

Just watching them today, it looks like they've been together forever, but...
Could it be that neither of them even realizes it...?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Now that you mention it... huh?
Is that, right?"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Like, I'd be doing something, and when I look to the side,
Blast-chan would just be right there... ya know?"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Right? Like, whenever I think "Man, this is fun!", Kiseki's always right there, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Right, right, right! Whether the fun came first or Blast-chan came first... I don't really know, but—

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Waha! There's no doubt it's way more fun together!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki & Blast
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaay!

...It's amazing you didn't notice until now,
but that just shows how connected you two were.
choice_data_list: I can't help but find this completely heartwarming...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Best friends...! Yes, the kind of pals who connect soul-to-soul!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer's my partner,
and Blast-chan's my bestie...
Whoa, I'm seriously so blessed—"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki! Look, it's the turf repair crew!
They're working as fast as ever!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, you're right, it's blindingly fast! Let me take a closer look!
...Even so, she doesn't look like she's going to stop anytime soon.
Watching the two close friends fool around from afar, I simply shrugged my shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki & Blast
text_block_list.text:
You think so?
Is that how it is~?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Well, if it makes you smile,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
More smiling faces are always welcome!

Irreplaceable best friends who understand each other.
It was an event that made one wish to watch over their friendship forever.
